Analysis of cell subset distribution across tumor, adjacent normal, and peripheral blood in the CRC anti-PD-1 cohort (GSE236581, 957,342 cells across 22 patients).

MAJOR LINEAGE DISTRIBUTION:
- Tumor (n=279,886): T cells 42.5%, Epithelial 28.2%, B cells 17.0%, Stromal 6.2%, Myeloid 4.2%, ILC 1.9%
- Normal (n=260,294): T cells 27.9%, Epithelial 35.6%, B cells 24.9%, Stromal 8.9%, Myeloid 1.8%, ILC 0.9%

CELL TYPES SPECIFICALLY AND HIGHLY ENRICHED ONLY IN THE TUMOR MICROENVIRONMENT:

25 sub-cell types met the dual criterion of ≥2-fold enrichment over both normal tissue and blood with Fisher p < 0.05. The most tumor-exclusive (by proportion of all cells found in tumor):

1. c79_Fibro_FAP (98.8% in tumor) — FAP+ cancer-associated fibroblasts; 74.6-fold vs normal, absent in blood

5. c09_CD4_Th1_CXCL13_HAVCR2 (96.3%) — Exhausted CD4+ Th1 cells; 24.7-fold vs normal
6. c23_CD8_Tex_LAYN (95.4%) — Exhausted CD8+ T cells; 19.9-fold vs normal; 4.1% of all tumor cells
7. c63_Mph_CCL20 (92.8%) — CCL20+ macrophages; 12.9-fold vs normal
8. c53_Neu_CXCR2 (91.5%) — CXCR2+ tumor-associated neutrophils; 15.0-fold vs normal
9. c13_CD4_Treg_TNFRSF9 (87.9%) — Activated FOXP3+TNFRSF9+ Tregs; 6.9-fold vs normal; 2.9% of tumor
10. c55_pDC_GZMB (87.3%) — GZMB+ plasmacytoid dendritic cells; 6.6-fold vs normal
11. c60_cDC_LAMP3 (82.3%) — LAMP3+ mature dendritic cells; 5.2-fold vs normal
12. c91_Epi_Tumor (81.8%) — Tumor-specific malignant epithelial cells; 4.2-fold vs normal; 7.6% of tumor
13. c62_Mph_S100A8 (81.6%) — S100A8+ macrophages; 4.4-fold vs normal
14. c27_CD8_MAIT_SLC4A10 (78.7%) — MAIT cells; 3.5-fold vs normal; 2.1% of tumor
15. c47_PlasmaB_IGHG1 (78.2%) — IgG1+ plasma cells; 3.5-fold vs normal; 2.8% of tumor
16. c81_Pericyte_RGS5 (77.1%) — Pericytes; 3.2-fold vs normal
17. c12_CD4_Treg_KLRB1 (74.8%) — KLRB1+ Tregs; 2.8-fold vs normal; 1.9% of tumor
18. c20_CD8_Tem_GZMK (72.0%) — GZMK+ effector memory CD8+ T cells; 2.4-fold vs normal; 6.1% of tumor
19. c34_ILC_NR4A2 (72.0%) — NR4A2+ ILCs; 2.5-fold vs normal; 1.4% of tumor
20. c07_CD4_Th17_CTSH (84.9%) — Th17 cells; 5.3-fold vs normal; 1.2% of tumor

The TME is characterized by: (1) T cell exhaustion/dysfunction (CD8+Tex LAYN+, CD4+Th1 CXCL13+HAVCR2+); (2) activated immunosuppressive Tregs (TNFRSF9+); (3) FAP+ cancer-associated fibroblasts; (4) functionally diverse tumor-associated macrophages (SPP1+, CCL20+, S100A8+); (5) active angiogenesis (COL4A1+ endothelial, proliferating endothelium, pericytes); (6) tumor-specific epithelial cells; and (7) IgG1+ plasma cells. Several of these populations (CD8+Tex, SPP1+ macrophages, FAP+ CAFs) showed strong association with immunotherapy outcome in the response-stratified analysis.
